name: Charred Vale
summary: In southwestern Stonetalon, flames and smoke consume the Charred Vale. The Venture Company's logging left a once thriving woodland in ruins, where fire elementals roam and Bloodfury harpies guard their territory.

sections.title: A Scorched Woodland
sections.body: The Charred Vale was once a thriving woodland in a basin of southwestern Stonetalon. Majestic treants guarded it, while native chimaeras and harpies made their home among the trees. The Venture Company brought the ruin. Its goblins clear-cut the forest with explosive machinery, corrupting the treants and waking chaotic fire elementals. The treants eventually drove the goblins back, but the loggers left the land broken and scarred by fire. Whatever foul devices they used as they retreated also tainted the valley.

sections.title: Struggles of Renewal
sections.body: Blackened ancients wander blindly through smoke and ash, among enraged elementals. Bloodfury harpies roost in skeletal snags and defend what remains of their territory. Druids from Sun Rock Retreat refuse to abandon the valley. They send travelers to sow enchanted seeds and tend the corrupted ancients as they work to reclaim the scorched earth.

faq.q: Why is the Charred Vale on fire?
faq.answer: The Venture Company's ruthless logging set the Charred Vale ablaze. Its destructive machinery and aggressive deforestation enraged the land's primal spirits and unleashed fire elementals that spread through the valley.

faq.q: Can the forest in the Charred Vale ever recover?
faq.answer: Tauren druids from nearby Sun Rock Retreat believe the forest can recover. They ask travelers to soothe the maddened treants and plant enchanted earthen seeds in the ash, hoping green shoots will rise from the ruined soil.

faq.q: What creatures inhabit the Charred Vale?
faq.answer: Hostile fire elementals, blackened and vengeful ancients, Scorched Basilisks, and wild chimaeras inhabit the Charred Vale. Bloodfury harpies plague the basin as well.

faq.q: What was the Charred Vale called before it burned?
faq.answer: The Charred Vale's original name has been lost to time. Long before goblin axes arrived, it was renowned as a lush woodland sanctuary.

angles.text: As a druid, you can see how uncontrolled greed shattered the natural balance here. The valley remains a focus of reclamation efforts.
From Sun Rock Retreat, Horde forces work with Cenarion allies to contain the elemental unrest and push back the Venture Company's lingering corruption.
